What is the learning modality?: For undergraduate programs, classes are conducted purely onsite. For graduate studies, we follow a hyflex learning model.
I don’t have a failing mark but I obtain: Yes, you will be considered an irregular student. Completing the requirements for an INC or NC does not automatically mean you’ve passed the course. You must fulfill the necessary requirements to clear the mark before continuing in your program.
I passed all my major subjects but faile: Yes, you would be considered an irregular student. To track the regular offering of your program and understand the proper course progression, please refer to your curriculum guide.
I am an irregular student and am require: Unfortunately, you are required to enroll onsite. However, you may designate someone to enroll on your behalf. They will need to present an authorization letter, a copy of your student ID, and their own valid ID.
Can I enroll beyond the allowable maximu: Typically, no. However, if you are a graduating student for the term, you may request an exception, subject to approval from your department head or dean.
Why did I receive the message: 'Please r: This message is issued when a student has failed 40% or more of their academic load. You are required to meet with your department head or faculty adviser to discuss your academic standing and potential next steps.
Can I enroll in advanced subjects?: Yes, you may enroll in advanced subjects as long as you have passed the prerequisite courses and have received approval from your department head. Additionally, the total number of units must fall within the allowable maximum units for the term.
How much is the tuition fee?: For an estimated breakdown of tuition fees, please refer to the program catalog available on the official SLU website: www.slu.edu.ph.
I don’t have enough money to pay right n: To ensure your enrollment is finalized and you are not removed from your classes, it is important to make the payment as soon as possible. Delayed payment may affect your enrollment status.
Can I pay online?: Yes, you can make payments online through our official payment portals. Please refer to the payment guidelines on the SLU website for more details.
I want to shift to another program. What: If you are shifting to a program within your current school, visit the department head of the intended program for guidance. If you are transferring between different schools (e.g., from SEA to SAMCIS), please contact or email the Guidance Office for evaluation and further instructions.
Why can’t I see any available blocks in: The blocks may either be closed or fully booked. To resolve this, please visit your respective onsite enrollment area for assistance.
Why do I only see one block available in: The block you see is the only one currently available. Additional blocks may open later, so it’s worth checking back periodically.
Will I be allowed to shift or change blo: Generally, no. You are not allowed to change blocks or schedules. However, schedule changes may occur if an additional subject you wish to take conflicts with your current schedule. In such cases, you may need to coordinate with the enrollment office for further assistance.
If I find a student who is willing to sw: While it’s possible for students to coordinate with one another, there’s no guarantee that you will be able to secure the other student’s slot. This is because online and onsite enrollment are happening simultaneously, and slots may be filled quickly.
The course I need to take is not offered: Yes, you may petition to have the course opened. However, the course will only be offered if a minimum of 35 students petition for it. If the number of petitioners falls short, additional payment may be required, which will depend on the number of students willing to pay and who will be assigned to handle the class. Please contact your department head to submit your petition. This should be done before or on the first day of enrollment. If the petitioned class does not reach 35 students, a letter from your parent (with a valid ID for verification) is required, indicating their understanding of the petition process.
I was not enrolled last term and I want: Since you were not enrolled last term, you will need to email readmission@slu.edu.ph to request readmission. After receiving approval, please visit your respective enrollment area to complete your enrollment process.
I am a regular student and I cannot enro: This means there is a restriction on your enrollment that needs to be cleared. Please visit the University Registrar’s Window 10 at the Diego Silang Main Campus. Once you’ve been cleared at their office, the restriction will be lifted, allowing you to complete your enrollment.
